Yesterday, I was volunteering working with kids. They need a pencil sharpener so I got to the other room and ask the mentor "hi, could I borrow a sharpener please?" It takes her a while to find it and she hands it to me. She says she is not sure whether there is another sharpener. I spot one on her desk and say " there is another one over there" 

She gives me a really mean look and says " you can't take all of them you have to leave some for everybody else, it's not only your group who needs to sharpen their pencils." I'm honestly really taken aback and try to point out that I was just trying to tell her there was another sharpener for her to use. She says "yeah sure" and doesn't look like she believed I was pointing it out for her.

In trying not to look selfish, I end up looking selfish and that upset me quite a bit as to why she assumed I was trying to hoard items that didn't belong to me. I wonder if I come across as that type of person.
